The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `5672` (see `ServiceBusBuilder.ServiceBusPort`)
- Port: `5300` (see `ServiceBusBuilder.ServiceBusHttpPort`)
- Environment variable: `SQL_WAIT_INTERVAL=0`
- Environment variable: `SQL_SERVER=database-container`
- Environment variable: `MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=yourStrong(!)Password`
- Dependency: `mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-CU14-ubuntu-22.04`
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `Emulator Service is Successfully Up!` is logged.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /health` to port `5300` is completed successfully.
